objective: Repair stale commit-preparation recovery with audited cancellation while preserving completed T04 lineage and cumulative spent attempts

acceptance.text: Audited commit-cancel requires exact run/token/revision, original ref and parent, clean index, unchanged protected Git state and passing cumulative scope; archives cancelled preparation without creating adopted-commit evidence or changing source, baseline, original histories or attempt counters.

State-changing Execution transition/correction refuses a pending preparation before story/run writes or attempt spending; true no-op resume remains no-op. PM cancellation and normal reprepare/adopt/finish work without a new permission checkpoint.

Real disposable Git regressions cover source changes, previously legal correction leaving stale pending, fresh-process cancellation, stale token/revision, moved HEAD/ref, staged index and protected metadata rejection, and successful full adoption after reconciliation. Earlier T04 lifecycle and cumulative evidence invariants remain enforced.
